log_level.description: Log verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error)

log_file.description: Path to the guider log file

monitoring_interval.description: Interval in seconds between resource monitoring samples

monitoring_enabled.description: Enable or disable continuous resource monitoring

profiling_output_dir.description: Directory to store profiling output files

tracing_enabled.description: Enable or disable system call/function tracing

tracing_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for tracing operations

visualization_port.description: HTTP port for the visualization web interface

visualization_host.description: Bind address for the visualization web interface

control_socket_path.description: Path to the Unix domain socket for control commands

logging_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size in MB of each log file before rotation

logging_max_files.description: Maximum number of rotated log files to retain

networking_listen_address.description: Network address to bind for networked features

networking_listen_port.description: Network port to bind for networked features

testing_enabled.description: Enable testing mode (disables some safety checks)

utilities_output_dir.description: Directory for utility output data and state files
